title: Spatial variation shapes lichen-associated bacterial and fungal communities more than host identity or season
description: We performed both 16S rRNA and ITS amplicon sequencing to evaluate the effects of lichen host, season and location on lichen bacterial and fungal diversity. Samples were collected from two lichen species (Parmotrema sp. and Flavopunctelia flaventior) from three different urban locations (Bryanston, Melville Koppies and Pretoria) in both summer (March) and winter (June) seasons.
